subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Digital tools are helpful servants but poor masters.”?
options: Sometimes a small change helps more people than we first think.
When people depend on them completely, a small failure can create a large silence.
Sometimes losing one small comfort helps people find other ways to use time.
Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Sometimes a small change helps more people than we first think.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Digital tools are helpful servants but poor masters. When people depend on them completely, a small failure can create a large silence.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes losing one small comfort helps people find other ways to use time.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Digital tools are helpful servants but poor masters. When people depend on them completely, a small failure can create a large silence.」，答案為「When people depend on them completely, a small failure can create a large silence.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「When people depend on them completely, a small failure can create a large silence.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
